name: Stargazing Season
source:
You, a teenage music prodigy, have been invited to attend the famed Elysian Summer Idol Camp as an idol team coordinator. Meet up-and-coming idol hopefuls, roll your eyes at the eccentric camp staff, and help your team achieve their idol dreams! Who knows? You might just find that special someone during your wondrous week at the University of Elysium!

[From [url=https://stardial-games.itch.io/stargazing-season-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你，一个音乐神童，受邀作为偶像团队协调员参加著名的极乐世界偶像夏令营。结识崭露头角的偶像候选人，对古怪的训练营工作人员翻白眼，帮助你的团队实现他们的偶像梦想！谁知道？在极乐世界大学度过美好的一周时，你可能会遇到那个特别的人！

[来自[url=https://stardial-games.itch.io/stargazing-season-demo]itch.io[/url]]
